title: Murder Island platform poster
slide_intent: Let imagery and lettering establish a programme’s tone while keeping its source visible, because viewers need both intrigue and attribution.
strategic_value: The narrow spaced title over a dark island scene can give this Channel 4 programme a different mood from its sport and comedy campaigns.
demonstration: A wide railway-platform billboard places the pale spaced Murder Island title over a low island and water image, with a small green 4 and streaming prompt at upper left.
practical_value: Assess how a thin, widely spaced title reads against a detailed landscape in outdoor use.

content_islands.name: Broadcaster cue
content_islands.spec: Place the green 4 and small streaming line at the top-left edge of the poster.

content_islands.name: Title and landscape
content_islands.spec: Carry the narrow pale title across the water-and-island scene.

content_islands.name: Outdoor placement
content_islands.spec: Retain the billboard frame, foliage, platform and tracks to show its physical context.

reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates this treatment in a railway-platform billboard.
